name: What is the average cost of a custom tiny home built by Zen Tiny Homes?

mainEntity.name: What is the average cost of a custom tiny home built by Zen Tiny Homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a custom tiny home varies significantly based on size, materials, features, and level of customization. Our homes typically range from $70,000 to $150,000. This estimate includes design, construction, and standard finishes. Premium materials, advanced off-grid systems, or complex architectural features will increase the overall investment. We provide a detailed quote after understanding your specific requirements during the initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: The average cost for a custom tiny home with Zen Tiny Homes ranges from $70,000 to $150,000, depending on size, materials, and customization.
